environment.description: Flask application deployed on an EC2 instance (Amazon Linux 2, t3.medium) behind an Application Load Balancer with default listener rules (forward all to target group). Security group allows inbound TCP/443 from 0.0.0.0/0. ALB has no AWS WAF WebACL associated. The application is exposed at https://internal-tools.example.com/api/* and accessible to any authenticated corporate user via Okta SSO at the ALB level (OIDC action), but the /api/users/search and /api/reports/export endpoints pass query parameters directly to SQLite without parameterization.
